data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘luminaris’, meaning ‘shining’, ‘bright’, or ‘light’. In Christian tradition, Loria represents the light of God and the divine illumination in one’s spiritual journey. The name Loria carries the meaning “Light, Bright, Shining” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Loria usually hope their child will grow to embody light, bright, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
